scope: One development-informed refinement pass on all 14 frozen development cases. No held-out evaluation or post-score tuning.
evidence: Exactly reads_sim01 mapped simulated read PAF in every case. No BAM fallback, pooling, or new mapping. CIGAR-contiguous 1 kb anchors, MAPQ20, at least 2 distinct molecules; zero spans is neutral. Whole-contig correction plan is deferred under review policy if any boundary meets the continuity threshold.
scoring: Unchanged independent scorer. Frozen inputs verified and all output/run hashes per policy committed before evaluator access. Keep candidate version, policy, correction mode and operation separate.
interpretation: Thresholds were informed by known development examples. Separate implementation/provenance scoring does not make the development cohort independent of refinement. Inspection does not confirm an error or repair sequence; no orientation normalization, accepted decisions or scripted replay are in these automatic arms.
